name: Grade 2 Mathematics: Addition of two-digit numbers
subject: Mathematics
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to add two two-digit numbers without regrouping
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to solve word problems involving addition
learningActivities: Mental warm-up: quick-fire addition facts within 10
Concrete stage: learners use bundles of sticks to add tens and ones
Pictorial stage: learners use number lines and base-ten pictures
Abstract stage: learners solve addition sums in their exercise books
keyPoints: Add the ones first, then the tens
The answer in addition is called the sum
commonMisconceptions: Adding across columns (e.g. adding 4 + 2 as tens)
Forgetting to write the answer under the correct place value
lessonEvaluation: Learners complete five addition sums and two word problems. Teacher marks and gives feedback.
teacherReflection: Concrete and pictorial stages helped. A few learners still add across columns - provide remedial work.
